title: Free-body diagram of a box on an incline
caption: Three forces only: weight (9.8 N per kg, straight down), the normal force 8.49 N perpendicular to the slope, and friction up the slope. At rest friction balances the slope component of the weight, mg sin 30° = 4.9 N; there is no separate "downhill force" arrow.
alt: Free-body diagram for 1 kilogram on a 30 degree slope: weight down, normal force perpendicular to the slope, friction up the slope.
description: Weight 9.8 N per kg, vertically down.
Normal force mg cos 30° = 8.49 N, perpendicular to the slope.
Friction up the slope, equal to mg sin 30° = 4.9 N while the box stays at rest.
The three forces sum to zero.
